newsitem.title: USA: Girlfriend cuts off California man's penis.
newsitem.headline: Girlfriend cuts off California man's penis.

text.p: A man was in serious condition in a California hospital on Saturday after his girlfriend cut off his penis with a butcher's knife, officials said.

Police said they found the man with his penis cut off when they responded to an emergency call Thursday from a home in Seaside, 100 miles (160 kms) south of San Francisco. Police did not release the man's name but he was identified in press reports as Julio Luna, 20.
Luna's live-in girlfriend, Daisy Mascada, 18, told police he had beaten her in a drunken rage and that she had cut off his penis with a serrated butcher's knife after he passed out, police said.

Luna was rushed to Community Hospital of the Monterey Peninsula, where he underwent surgery to reattach the severed penis, local news reports said. The reports said it was still unclear if the reattachment surgery was a complete success.
A hospital spokeswoman would say only that Luna remained in serious condition Saturday.

Mascada was arrested on suspicion of spousal battery, mayhem and assault with a deadly weapon, Seaside police said. They said she was first taken to a local hospital for treatment of unspecified injuries and was later booked into Monterey County Jail.

The incident is similar to the celebrated case of Lorena Bobbitt, who cut off the penis of her husband John Wayne Bobbitt with a kitchen knife in June 1993 as he slept in the bedroom of their Virginia home. The organ was recovered and surgeons reattached it.

Tried on a charge of malicious wounding, Lorena Bobbitt said she acted out of an "irresistible impulse" after her husband allegedly raped her, culminating four years of beatings, sexual assaults and verbal abuse. Her husband denied abusing her.
In January 1994, a Virginia jury found Lorena Bobbitt innocent by reason of temporary insanity.
